notes.statement: Sheet 033 separates bay spacing, bracket spacing, column-top levels and inward inclination. Its bay caption identifies parenthesized figures as upper bay measurements; the level caption refers to a horizontal reference line. These are distinct measurement bases, not interchangeable floor heights or a single ideal grid.

notes.statement: The repair plan explicitly prints AREA 209,19 M2. Reading its overall chains as 17.880 m and 11.700 m gives 209.196 m², only 0.006 m² above that annotation. This strongly supports that metric interpretation within repair 045. It does not establish whether punctuation denotes decimal metres or grouped millimetres, a set-wide unit declaration, or the measurement heights of survey 033.

evidence.locator_note: Printed 045, top total 17.880, right total 11.700, lower-right AREA209,19M2

notes.review_note: Two agents visually read area and span labels; main agent calculated 17.880 × 11.700 = 209.196. Difference retained, not rounded away. Check is of a dimensional consistency inference; raw linear records remain unit-null/pending.
notes.assumptions: Area refers to the rectangle bounded by the outer post-centre grid. Decimal-metre and grouped-millimetre interpretations yield the same physical spans. Transfer to matched repair 050 is a provisional modeling interpretation, not an explicit source unit statement.
